title: Redwood April 2026 Leadership Update
summary: Leadership provided a company-level update covering Q1 results, product milestones for Dedicated and Private deployments, a new roadmap milestone for Redwood Optimize, hiring priorities, and compliance progress (SOC 2 readiness). Leadership reiterated focus on reliability, cost controls, and enterprise GTM. Session closed with Q&A and concrete next steps for decks, security docs, and a cross-functional launch plan.
transcript:
[00:00] Anita Rao: Hey everyone, thanks for joining. We'll get started in a minute, appreciate you making time. Um, quick note, we'll record this for folks who can't make it.
[00:10] Jules Park: Quick admin, shout-out to central ops for the town hall setup, looks good.
[00:25] Anita Rao: Okay. High level — Q1 was solid. Revenue growth beat plan by, like, 8% on bookings, and we've seen strong momentum on Dedicated contracts. Diego, want to pull the numbers?
[00:40] Diego Martinez: Yeah, quick numbers: bookings up 8% vs plan, ARR net new adds were mainly mid-market and a couple of larger enterprise deals for Dedicated. Latency SLOs are stable, and our perf team pushed a kernel improvement that dropped p95 by ~12% on the 32k-context models in internal benchmarks — still tuning but promising.
[01:05] Maya Patel: And on product, Dedicated GA is going well — a couple of customers are in their pilot-to-prod transition. We're seeing requests for more deterministic latency and stronger SLAs, which maps to our Dedicated roadmap items.
[01:20] Samir Desai: Ops note: autoscaling for Dedicated pools hit a snag in one case last week — we had an issue with the scaling policy and a noisy neighbor effect. We've patched the policy and added better tracing to detect it earlier. No customer-facing downtime.
[01:40] Audience (someone): Can you repeat the noisy neighbor detail?
[01:44] Samir Desai: Yeah, essentially an allocation algorithm edge case; long story short, fixed, monitoring added.
[01:52] Anita Rao: Thanks. On Private — we've closed two pilots for regulated customers this quarter. The private control plane work is moving into stage two, and KMS/HSM integration is on track.
[02:05] Jules Park: Sales is seeing an uptick in RFPs with security filters — SOC 2 and SSO are table stakes. We shipped the SOC 2 readiness docs to three prospects last month which helped unblock procurement conversations.
[02:22] Diego Martinez: Small caveat on Private: some customers request on-prem packaging, and that increases testing matrix — we need a more prescriptive compatibility guide. Action item there.
[02:35] Maya Patel: Product highlight — Redwood Optimize alpha has internal wins: batching/caching suggestions reduced token cost by ~15% in test workloads. We're opening a closed beta next month for select customers.
[02:50] Audience (someone): Is Optimize going to be part of hosted pricing or an add-on?
[02:54] Jules Park: Plan is add-on initially, enterprise tier, but we'll revisit based on feedback.
[03:00] Anita Rao: A few operational metrics to call out — SRE MTTR down 20% since the observability rollouts, console adoption up 30% in active routes, and support NPS improved slightly.
[03:20] Diego Martinez: Tech deep dive — we're rolling a new KV-cache eviction policy that helps long-tail prefix reuse. It's behind a feature flag and improves p50 token throughput under mixed workloads. Some of the tuning is model-specific; that's why the kernel selector work is important.
[03:45] Maya Patel: Roadmap/OKRs for next quarter: 1) Harden Dedicated autoscale and SLAs, 2) Public beta for Optimize, 3) SOC 2 certification, 4) Expand partner integrations in APAC.
[04:00] Anita Rao: Hiring priorities — we'll ramp SRE and Enterprise Solutions Engineers; note for hiring managers: focus on candidates with private deployment experience and enterprise compliance background.
[04:20] Audience (question): Any update on pricing changes?
[04:23] Jules Park: No immediate pricing changes for hosted; we'll run a pricing experiment for Dedicated bundles later this quarter.
[04:30] Anita Rao: Fundraising update — no immediate plans to raise right now, runway is healthy post-Series C growth, but we'll keep options open.
[04:40] Audience (someone): Any product callouts for partners?
[04:44] Maya Patel: Yes — we're packaging a partner-facing quickstart for on-prem/reseller workflows. Small beta with two partners next month.
[05:00] Anita Rao: Okay Q&A — please keep questions short so we can get through as many as possible.
[05:10] Audience Member 1: On SOC 2, what's blocking certification timeline?
[05:14] Diego Martinez: Mostly evidence collection and a couple of control gaps around change management; auditors are aligned, and we expect cert in Q3 if we keep pace.
[05:24] Audience Member 2: Anything to note on reliability for hosted API — we've seen a handful of spikes in token latency last month.
[05:30] Samir Desai: Those were correlated with a single job that caused suboptimal scheduling; we've added isolation and a scheduling cap so it shouldn't recur.
[05:40] Audience Member 3: Can you speak to Dedicated SLAs — are those standard or negotiable?
[05:44] Jules Park: Standard templates for SLA, but we can negotiate for large enterprise deals; legal needs time for bespoke terms.
[05:52] Anita Rao: Closing thoughts — keep shipping, focus on enterprise friction points, and be pragmatic about reliability. We'll share the deck and the SOC 2 playbook after the call.
[06:08] Diego Martinez: Quick tech note for folks in infra — kernel selector improvements are going to require some model ops changes; will sync with teams next week.
[06:20] Maya Patel: Also, product will circulate the Optimize beta invite list — if you know customers to include, add them to the form.
[06:30] Anita Rao: Thanks everyone. We'll follow up with the all-hands notes and the action list. Meeting adjourned.
next_steps: Share all-hands slide deck (Maya to publish by 2026-04-22)
Circulate SOC 2 readiness playbook to GTM and SRE (Diego by 2026-04-27)
Open Optimize closed beta invites and collect pilot customers (Maya by 2026-05-05)
Patch Dedicated autoscale docs and release compatibility guide (Samir/Infra by 2026-05-01)

Diego Martinez: SOC 2 evidence collection plan and playbook (due 2026-04-27)
